title: Evolving OpenAI’s structure
summary: An update from the OpenAI board on transitioning its for-profit entity to a Public Benefit Corporation, reinforcing its mission-driven structure under nonprofit oversight while enabling greater impact and long-term alignment with the public good.
body: An update from the OpenAI board on transitioning its for-profit entity to a Public Benefit Corporation, reinforcing its mission-driven structure under nonprofit oversight while enabling greater impact and long-term alignment with the public good.
summaryZh: OpenAI董事会宣布将公司结构从非营利组织控制的实体转型为公共利益公司（Public Benefit Corporation）。这一重大架构调整旨在平衡商业化发展与非营利使命，通过强化治理结构，确保公司在追求技术突破的同时，能够更好地履行对公众利益的承诺。此举不仅影响了OpenAI的融资与运营模式，也为AI行业如何平衡商业利益与社会责任提供了新的治理范式，对行业长期发展具有深远影响。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI公司架构调整为公共利益公司，对其长期发展战略与治理模式具有深远影响。

glossary.explanationZh: 公共利益公司，一种兼顾营利与社会责任的商业实体形式。
治理，指公司内部的决策机制与权力制衡结构。
